data.rationale: The proposal has the same procedure in the same order (Plan, Fare Finder, From, To Anywhere, budget, Let's go) and names origin and budget as parameters. It also lists destination as a parameter even though it is fixed to Anywhere, and the budget step says only "pick a value", so an automation would work but the spec is slightly loose.
